name: Karpov
source:
Dreams. Kingdom come. The Astral. How connected are they? Is it possible to dive into a conscious dream and pave a path to those who are no longer with us? A far more troubling question is whether it is possible to go back alone.
But THEY will know...

The main character will have to find his own answers. Who is a friend and who is an enemy? Maxim has to wade through thorns to help his loved ones and try not to fall into the trap himself. He will be hunted by entities that he could not imagine. What's real and what's not? Face-to-face with the inexplicable, dangers, hard decisions, and trials at the limit.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328680/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
梦想。王国降临。星界。他们之间的联系如何？是否有可能潜入有意识的梦想，为那些不再与我们在一起的人铺平道路？更令人不安的问题是是否有可能独自回去。
但他们会知道…

主角必须找到自己的答案。谁是朋友，谁是敌人？马克西姆必须披荆斩棘去帮助他所爱的人，同时尽量不让自己落入陷阱。他将被他无法想象的实体追捕。什么是真实的，什么不是？面对无法解释的危险、艰难的决定和极限的考验。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328680/]Steam[/url]]
